title: Implement mxo-track logistics platform (agent-native)
description: Implement the complete mxo-track last-mile logistics platform following agent-native architecture. File-based entity directories, atomic tool scripts (bash+jq+Python), composable workflows. 8 phases, 47 atomic commits.
acceptance_criteria: All entity schemas defined in schemas/
CRUD tools for all entities in tools/
CSV import working with sample data
Route execution workflow (start, deliver, exception, POD, complete)
Reporting tools (delivery stats, driver performance, customer report)
Cost analysis and dashboard data tools
